title: Induced EMF magnitude
description: Essential: The response must correctly calculate the motional EMF as E = BLv, yielding 0.8 V.

title: Tension force magnitude
description: Essential: The response must correctly calculate the tension force as F = BIL = B(E/R)L, yielding 0.8 N.

title: Heat generated
description: Essential: The response must correctly calculate the heat generated as Q = I²Rt = (E²/R)t, yielding 0.32 J.

title: Force balance reasoning
description: Important: The response must apply Newton's first law, stating that for constant velocity, the tension force equals the magnetic (Ampere) force.

title: Time in field
description: Important: The response must correctly determine the time the coil is in the field as t = 2L/v, since the full coil width must enter and exit.

title: Circuit analysis
description: Important: The response must apply Ohm's law (I = E/R) to find the induced current.

title: Incorrect active length
description: Pitfall: Using an incorrect length (e.g., perimeter or 4L) in the EMF formula E = BLv instead of the side length L.

title: Sign or unit error
description: Pitfall: Making a sign error in force direction, omitting units in final answers, or using inconsistent units leading to incorrect numerical results.

title: Energy approach check
description: Optional: Using an energy conservation approach (work done by tension equals heat generated) to verify the result for force or heat.
